name: Release Matcher

settings.label: Sources Manifest URL
settings.description: Remote JSON manifest listing feed sources, Usenet crawlers, and trackers fetched automatically (used when Release Index URL is blank).

settings.label: Release Index URL (Optional)
settings.description: Optional: base URL of a pre-built release index server (HTTPS or localhost). Overrides live source fetching when set.

settings.label: ameNZB API Key (Optional)
settings.description: Optional: paste your personal ameNZB API key to enable ameNZB Newznab searches alongside keyless Usenet crawlers. Never shared or logged.

settings.label: Include Usenet crawlers (Binsearch / NZBKing / NZBIndex / ameNZB)
settings.description: Query keyless Usenet crawlers (and ameNZB when your key is set above) for dead-swarm and rare releases.

settings.label: Extra Feed URLs (Optional)
settings.description: Optional comma-separated extra RSS 2.0, Torznab 1.3, or JSON feed URLs queried alongside the Sources Manifest.

settings.label: Fetch AniZip mappings
settings.description: Fetch and cache AniList-to-AniDB/TVDB episode mappings locally for more accurate season, episode, and ID-based matching.

description: Runs Shiru's full episode matcher, query ladder, verifier, and ranker locally inside the extension worker from a remote Sources Manifest (SeaDex, AnimeTosho, Nyaa, Sukebei, dmhy, Mikan, Usenet crawlers + optional ameNZB) or connects to a pre-built Release Index URL.
